column2: First basket = P(team scores first) x player share (model v2, 10/21). P(team scores first) comes from the two main jumpers' tip-win rates (log5) and the 25-26 league rate that the tip winner scores first (64%). Share = half his share of team first FGs + half his share of team first shots x (his FG% / league FG%), each shrunk toward 1 in 5; then x the opponent's rate of allowing the first FG to his position (G/F/C, shrunk hard, 0.85 to 1.15); then the probable five are rescaled to sum to 99%, so an Out starter's share goes to the rest in proportion. Backtest (936 games, Dec 25 to 10/20/26): log loss 2.283 vs 2.293 old, top pick 14.0% vs 13.9%; small but better. Fair odds are the break-even price; only bet when the book pays more. Points / threes = highest line with a 70%+ blended hit rate as a starter. Recheck starting lineups 30 minutes before tip. Opening night 10/20: the value longer shots hit (Collins +1000, Vassell +800) while the book favorites (Wembanyama, Embiid) missed, and Queta did not start. Lean to role starters priced well past fair, skip favorites priced under fair, and only bet a player once his start is confirmed.
